name: table-customer-guest-lifecycle
title: Restore table customer guest lifecycle
description: Reserve a table when customer details are saved, then create or attach the guest customer when the first dine-in order is persisted.
creator: LQVCohan
notes: Saving meaningful customer data now conditionally transitions only available tables to reserved and emits a restaurant-scoped realtime event. The first persisted dine-in order hydrates identity from TableCustomer only when reservation/explicit customer data is absent, then reuses ensureUserForOrder for the existing 30-day guest flow and writes the resolved id back best-effort. The existing order mutation remains responsible for occupied status. Focused tests, GraphQL checks and build were not executed in the connected environment.
